character.motivation: Keeps track of which tea cups belong to which neighbors. Wants families to feel welcome while they make claims.
character.voice: Dry commercial jokes with deliberate moments of generosity.
character.backstory: Cyrus carried hot water to the ferry landing the night the river rose. Years later he still recognizes the displaced familiesâ€™ old orders faster than he recognizes their names.
character.quest_hook: Help Cyrus host a small claims-day tea where visitors can choose whether to meet the council or simply sit together.

dialogue.introduction: People bring me gossip for free. I charge for the hot water.
dialogue.friendship: I used to remember orders instead of names. The ones who stopped coming were the ones I only knew by their tea.
dialogue.supper: I brought the chipped cups. They went first. People knew which ones they'd used before.
dialogue.hearing: The next pot is for the families coming in with claims. After that, people can argue and buy their own.
dialogue.favorite_gift: I'll slice this into the next pot. Tell me if the tea tastes too sweet.
dialogue.disliked_gift: The dry grass takes on the scent of everything in the cupboard. I'll pass.

routine.job: Sets out tea in the meadow
routine.hobby: Pours an afternoon cup at the commons
routine.home_context: Lives at the end of Orchard Row with a short walk down Reedmere Walk, where former ferry customers pass.
